sources.name: ICTV Virus Taxonomy Profile
sources.evidence_statement: ICTV classifies influenza A and B viruses; seasonal human lineages must be separated from avian, swine and other animal influenza.
sources.evidence_locator: ICTV online report chapter/genus or family page

sources.name: ViralZone Orthomyxoviridae
sources.evidence_statement: ViralZone provides a curated molecular and taxonomic overview used to cross-check accepted names, genome context and related viruses.

sources.name: WHO Seasonal influenza
sources.evidence_statement: The public-health source defines the human disease and surveillance scope used to distinguish target disease reports from taxonomy-only or near-neighbour mentions.

sources.name: CDC About Influenza
sources.evidence_statement: WHO seasonal influenza surveillance focuses on human A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2) and influenza B lineages, distinct from avian and swine influenza.
